title: feat(client-react)!: remove deprecated useQuery legacy query-field aliases (11.0)
body:
Removes the deprecated legacy query-field aliases from `@objectstack/client-react` `useQuery`/`useInfiniteQuery` (epic #2364, A3). Canonical names only: `select`→`fields`, `filters`→`where`, `sort`→`orderBy`, `top`→`limit`, `skip`→`offset`. One file; no framework consumers used the aliases; build+DTS+tsc clean. Rides into 11.0 (major changeset).
